# bce01: leave current camp danger after an actual failed bank approach

Base `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`, base bot
`leader_party_tuned`. Edit only `bots/pi_bank-camp-escape-01/` and write
IMPLEMENTATION.md. Independent experiment: do not inherit roster-pair, cd01,
dominant-objective, threat-skip, profiler or reliable-r08 changes.

## Evidence and hypothesis

Our frozen champion versus C02, Swirl side A, cached PC replay
champion-screen/00032.zip, current engine3 build
96ce858f548c14560eff737967a691a30eaf0a469afd1f4f400f125e094bd1fd:
Ren collected7gems at43/input652/substep12, shopped at spawn101 and resumed
camp work. Age70 makes banking due at113. From113 through150 he stays at
(18,13), retaining7gems, while a visible awake elk at(20,14), range4,
strength60 eventually removes720HP. At151 he reaches380/1100HP (<=35%),
the existing survival branch finally calls retreat, moves to(19,12), later
recalls156 and deposits7gems164/input2393/substep7.

Official replay-engine probes at113/input1722/substep7 establish restrictions0,
seven host-legal neighboring moves, and a locally visible enemy Ren at(10,17)
whose range1 cannot currently damage us. The awake elk covers EVERY adjacent
tile. A locally reconstructed selector path to the northern altar is
(18,13)->(19,12)->(20,11)->(21,10)->(22,9), but safe move_to adds the elk's
attack region and clears only the origin: no neighboring tile or alternative
safe altar path remains. This is origin isolation inside a current hazard,
not lack of physically legal movement. A host-legal step is not proof of safety.

No hard fuel pauses occur113–150. At113 the only non-yield action is an optional
ward after primary work; its >45000 fuel gate supports available30k field
admission. Source permits at most1pre-bank/selection field, the approach adds
another, existing retreat can use the third under max_fields3. Additional work
may still change budgets/trajectories elsewhere; measure it in release.

The existing retreat first tries safe spawn routing, then ranks locally legal
steps by incoming_at, enemy separation and spawn distance. incoming_at includes
visible awake camp damage as well as enemies. It already supplies the eventual
escape here; first steps may remain under equal camp damage while moving out.

Hypothesis: after a proven bank approach failure while already inside live camp
attack coverage, invoking that existing retreat earlier avoids waiting for low
HP and restores delivery. Do not add a new risk model or lower global danger
thresholds. This intentionally does NOT address Braided River's distinct case:
all altar goals excluded by enemy risk, no selected altar, permanent aged-bag
bank demand. The same Braided map versus C02 has ordinary successful banking,
so do not add map-name behavior or claim universal banking repair.

Prior art: reliable-r08 had a combined carrier mask/controller/backoff/blocker
system and lost49–123direct; its ablations did not isolate this branch. Reviewed
champion,C02,r08 and archived economy/banking sources do not call retreat after
this actual route failure. C02 changes accounting/channel guards, not routing.
Do not copy that larger package. PC-only replay files are not dependencies for
Pi implementation; this job contains the relevant evidence and source contract.

## Exact change

In existing bank(), only inside the branch handling move_to(...,safe=true)
result no_route_now OR invalid_goals:

1. Preserve current three-failure altar cooldown/clear behavior and its order.
2. If the TurnBudget is still current, inspect the existing refreshed snapshot
   (bank already calls observe after movement). If camp_hit is true and incoming
   is positive, and the budget is still current with fuel above Config::reserve,
   call the existing retreat(budget,memory) exactly once.
3. Return false as before: a retreat move is not a submitted bank/channel start.

Use the existing cached/current observation; do not add live threat scans,
fields, new movement helpers or altered retreat ranking. The only additional
work should come from the existing retreat function when this predicate holds.
Do not call it on deferred, wait, at_goal, moved, missing altar or empty bag.
Do not change the ordinary bank demand, age/bag/endgame thresholds, selector,
navigation masks, queue/courtesy, active-channel behavior, remembered task,
shop, roster, planner, coordination, combat or telemetry. Preserve all earlier
dispatcher survival/channel/recovery priorities. No new persistent memory or
explicit recall call. Let existing retreat guards handle immobility/restrictions.

Keep the branch bounded and do not enter the fallback after a round rollover.
The existing retreat's local rank queries can themselves consume fuel; preserve
its existing internal guards and do not claim the caller makes that code atomic
across a suspension. Record this risk for release testing. If the exact
source requires a minimal guard adaptation, document it instead of silently
expanding scope. Do not fix altar hysteresis or global no-candidate behavior.

## Focused correctness

Exercise actual production bank function with controlled SDK/link substitutes,
not a duplicated predicate. Prove failed safe approach+current camp hazard
invokes retreat once and still returns false; third-failure altar cooldown and
clear remain; ordinary successful approach/channel, no candidate, empty bag,
nonhazard failure, deferred/wait and crossed-round failure do not invoke the new
fallback. Check a retreat that moves and one that cannot move, with bounded
calls and no false bank accounting. Preserve existing meaningful state/protocol
tests and real-SDK production syntax checks. Document stub/host limitations;
Pi need not simulate engine gameplay. No logs or instrumentation in release.

## Frozen PC evaluation

Review exact source and release build under CLI5/currentengine3,normalfuel.
Standard80-game screen,8maps,5frozencontrols,both sides. Require zero candidate
VMfaults. Reject direct<8/16 OR common<31/64. Expand only direct>=9/16 AND
common>=35/64 (baseline33/64), plus verified useful mechanism; otherwise
inconclusive. Never upload on screening alone.

Preselected mechanism: Swirl/C02/A Ren's failed-bank interval113–151 and its
bank164, with same artifact/map/seed/opponent controls. Inspect release first
divergence and actual local camp coverage, legal actions, movement, carried
gems and deposit. If comparable, predict first egress before low-health151 and
deposit before164 without losing the bag. If trajectories diverge earlier,
identify the first relevant failed-route/escape episode instead of inventing
the original counterfactual. No verified fallback exposure means no mechanism
claim; use bounded diagnostics before expansion. Native checks alone do not
establish release strength or branch exposure.

Report whole matched64common games, banking/collection/loss/deaths/captures,
first100/whole fuel suspensions, caught errors, and both sides of Swirl. Inspect
whether the new retreat oscillates or makes ordinary banking worse. Keep all
games, not only successful escapes. The two already-run unchanged-champion/C02
Braided games are ordinary-bank controls; if the screen qualifies, run the
candidate against those same two conditions before any broader expansion.

All16 original confirmation maps are consumed by cd01. Future broad and fresh
confirmation need separately frozen new map/opponent conditions, with historical
exposure recorded. No ranked selection change or candidate upload in this job.
implementation_report:
# bce01: escape camp coverage after a failed bank approach

## Hypothesis and scope

Base: `2f0f534e8311ee597e516b11c2afca1bbf608060`; candidate cloned from
`leader_party_tuned`. An actual failed safe altar approach while already taking
live camp damage can isolate the carrier inside the safe navigation mask. Calling
the existing retreat at that point may restore movement and delivery before the
ordinary low-health survival branch activates. A physically legal adjacent move
does not establish safety; this experiment relies on the existing retreat policy.

The supplied Swirl/C02/A Ren episode (failed banking 113–150, low-health escape
151, deposit 164) motivates the change. It has not been reproduced on this Pi.
This does not address no-selected-altar banking demand, altar hysteresis, or the
distinct Braided River no-candidate case. No map-specific behavior was added.

Read the current banking and navigation strategy documents, tuned configuration
README, SDK API notes, and relevant C++ SDK/host-import declarations, alongside
banking, observation, navigation/retreat, and dispatcher source. The navigation
strategy document's historical admission/reserve figures differ from the tuned
source; this change uses the existing `Config::reserve` (5000) without changing
field admission (30000) or field quota (3).

## Actual changes

Only two production lines were added in `src/economy.cpp`, inside `bank()`'s
`no_route_now` / `invalid_goals` branch, after the unchanged three-failure altar
cooldown/clear operation:

- Check the current TurnBudget, then `camp_hit` and positive `incoming` from the
  stable snapshot already refreshed by the existing post-movement `observe()`.
- Recheck the budget and require fuel strictly above `Config::reserve`, then call
  `retreat(budget, memory)` once. Ignore its result and return false as before.

No added observation calls, threat scans, fields, persistent memory, recall,
release diagnostics, or new movement code. Existing retreat supplies any extra
work. Navigation, masks, retreat ranking/guards, demand thresholds, selector,
queue/courtesy, active channels, remembered tasks, accounting, shopping, roster,
planner, coordination, combat, telemetry, and dispatcher priorities are unchanged.
No roster-pair, cd01, dominant-objective, threat-skip, profiler, or reliable-r08
changes were inherited. No production guard adaptation was needed.

Added `tests/bank_escape.cpp` and `tests/run_native.py`. The harness links the
actual production `economy.cpp` against the checked-in real C++ SDK header,
controlled host imports, and link substitutes for `move_to`, `retreat`,
`choose_altar`, `observe`, and `fight`. It does not copy the bank predicate/body.
Unused shop code is discarded through section garbage collection. The runner
keeps all generated artifacts in a temporary directory and preserves the existing
tests. The existing exhaustive geometry test receives its expected generated
header containing the production chunk/center function bodies.

## Pi checks

Run from the checkout root:

```sh
python3 bots/pi_bank-camp-escape-01/tests/run_native.py
```

Results:

- Production bank contract harness: PASS. Both failure statuses invoke retreat
  exactly once for a refreshed camp hazard; moving and immobile retreat results
  both leave bank false with no submit call or bank accounting change. First
  failure retains the altar; third failure cooldown/clear occurs before retreat.
- Refreshed hazard replaces the pre-approach value. Missing camp coverage,
  zero/negative incoming, fuel at/below reserve, round crossing in movement,
  observation refresh, or the second current-round guard exclude the fallback.
  Nonhazard and crossed-round third failures retain the old cooldown behavior.
- Deferred, wait, at_goal, and moved statuses do not invoke retreat. Empty bag
  clears altar/queue; no selected candidate returns false. Ordinary movement into
  altar range starts submission with normal accounting; existing submission
  channels return normally. No false submission from a retreat result.
- Existing protocol/state scenarios: PASS.
- Existing exhaustive strategy contracts: PASS, 55,294,203 checks, 5,041 map
  dimensions, 21,298,225 tiles, 116,964 centers, 1,176,588 requests.
- Real-SDK production syntax check over every `src/*.cpp`: PASS with native GCC
  accommodations below.
- Compared candidate with `leader_party_tuned`: only `economy.cpp` differs among
  production files. HEAD matches the requested base. No files outside the
  candidate were edited; changes remain uncommitted.

Native GCC 13 rejects existing SDK `team()` declarations without `-fpermissive`;
existing objective/route code also needs `-include cmath` with this standard
library. The runner supplies these flags, preserving the SDK and production
sources. Initial unadapted syntax checks exposed these existing portability
issues. Existing SDK/formatting warnings remain visible in the runner output.

## Limits and pending frozen PC evaluation

These are caller contracts with controlled SDK/link substitutes. Retreat movement
and immobility are modeled return/position outcomes, not execution of real
retreat navigation or host legality, camp coverage, fields, fuel suspension,
engine channel timing, scoring completion, or gameplay. Native checks establish
neither release strength nor actual fallback exposure. CLI/uv, Clang/WASI and the
PC replay artifacts are unavailable here; no release WASM build or matches ran.
The historical Windows planner differential runner was preserved, not run.

The caller checks round/fuel before entry. Existing retreat local rank queries
can consume fuel and suspend within that function; its guards are unchanged.
This does not make retreat atomic across suspension. Measure release fuel,
round transitions, oscillation, and ordinary banking regressions on the PC.

PC handoff remains the supplied frozen protocol: review exact source and release
build with CLI5/current engine3, normal fuel (evidence engine build
`96ce858f548c14560eff737967a691a30eaf0a469afd1f4f400f125e094bd1fd`). Run all
80 screen games: 8 maps, 5 frozen controls, both sides, zero candidate VM faults.
Reject direct <8/16 or common <31/64. Expand only with direct >=9/16 and common
>=35/64 (baseline 33/64), plus a verified useful mechanism; otherwise inconclusive.
Never upload on screening alone.

Inspect Swirl/C02/A Ren against the same artifact/map/seed/opponent controls,
starting with release first divergence, actual local camp coverage, legal actions,
movement, bag retention and deposit. If comparable, the prediction is first
egress before low-health round 151 and deposit before 164 without losing the bag.
If earlier trajectories diverge, identify the first relevant failed-route/escape
episode instead. Without verified fallback exposure make no mechanism claim;
use bounded diagnostics before expansion. Inspect both sides of Swirl and retain
all games, including failed escapes. Report the entire matched 64 common games,
banking/collection/loss/deaths/captures, first-100 and whole-game fuel suspensions,
and caught errors. If qualified, run the same two preexisting Braided/C02 ordinary
bank controls before broader expansion.

All 16 original confirmation maps were consumed by cd01. Broad/fresh confirmation
requires separately frozen new map/opponent conditions and recorded historical
exposure. No ranked selection change, upload, commit, or push was performed.
